fields.title: ABIPCO search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Field names and shape mirror ABIPCO's own NameSearchPage API response verbatim -- this is a free public name-search facility, not a full registry-detail API, so fields are limited to what that facility itself returns.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), invalid_query (blank/whitespace-only query), or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

EntityID.title: Entity ID
EntityID.description: ABIPCO's internal GUID for this entity.

EntityName.title: Entity name
EntityName.description: Registered name of the company, business name, or friendly society.

EntityNumber.title: Registration number
EntityNumber.description: ABIPCO registration/entity number (e.g. C222/08 for a company, B1414/2022 for a business name, FS8/2017 for a friendly society).

DateOfIncorporation.title: Date of incorporation/registration
DateOfIncorporation.description: Date the entity was incorporated or registered, as recorded by ABIPCO. Absent for some older/legacy entities.

StatusName.title: Status
StatusName.description: Current register status, e.g. Active, Inactive.

StatusReason.title: Status reason
StatusReason.description: Reason for the current status when not Active, e.g. "Ceased/Struck-off/Removed". Null for active entities.

TypeName.title: Entity type
TypeName.description: Type of registered entity, e.g. Private Ordinary Company, Private Ordinary Foreign Company, Business By Individual, Business By Corporation, Friendly society.

PrincipalOfficeAddress.title: Principal office address
PrincipalOfficeAddress.description: Registered/principal office address on file, when available.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: The register this entity is held on -- always "Intellectual Property & Commerce Office" for Antigua and Barbuda entities.

CaricomStatus.title: CARICOM status
CaricomStatus.description: Whether the entity is domestic ("Antigua and Barbuda") or a foreign/external entity ("non-Antigua and Barbuda") per ABIPCO's own CARICOM classification.

LoweredApplicationName.title: Application/jurisdiction tag
LoweredApplicationName.description: Internal jurisdiction tag from the shared multi-country registry platform this search runs on -- always "antigua" for this actor.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each search-result record.
